report.question: Take a stratified sample of conclusions this program treats as SETTLED BY AGREEMENT (no executable test attached) and settle each one with an executable test written by an agent who does not see the agreed answer. What fraction of agreed conclusions the test refutes is the program's agreement-is-not-evidence rate, and it is the number that says whether any un-tested consensus in this program may be cited. Spec 11244 and 11198: agreement is not proof; evidence gates outrank popularity.
